title: The light is not always on...
text:
The light is not always on.... [[VIDEOID:dfe4772c732bf11aa61d84e5cff51cb5]] I like the vintage look of the clock, the size is just right and everything works fine. My only issues with it is that the light needs to be a pressed button and even then it's not light enough to light up the entire clock to truly read it correctly. So if you were hoping for a glowing clock at night, this is not it... and they put that in the description, I just happened to miss that detail.
The alarm seems like it's not lowed enough to wake you up at first but it goes from one level to a second, third and maybe a 4th of loud beeping. I personally just wanted a vintage clock that maybe glowed at night - or whenever you press the light on button. The light also works as a snooze button.
It's a good light, I would probably rather have spent about $11.99 for the functions I needed and what works compared to what the products mentions. It's not bad but it could use some improvements.

product_metadata.title: Vintage Retro Analog Alarm Clock, 4 inch Super Silent Non Ticking Small Clock with Night Light, Battery Operated, Simply Design, for Living Room, Bedroom, Bedside, Desk, Gift Clock (Arabic)
features: 【Vintage Design】 - The clock is designed in European retro style which making it looks very cool. Large numerals analog clock dial which is easy to read and use.
【Super Silent Hand】 - The sweep second hand does not make any annoying noise, make a super peaceful space for you to sleep and work.
【Simple Alarm Function】 - The moderate alarm volume will not surprise you and make you wake up easily. ON/OFF button can help you turn on/off the alarm easily.
【Night Light Function】 - Press the snooze button, you can light up the clock in the darkness, especially when you wake up at night. Small yellow light is friendly to protect your eyes.
【Battery Operated】 - This clock is operated by 1*AA battery(Not included). It is a great little clock for you to decorate your house.
